svg.text: Glugg on the 40×60 protoboard · step 1: where the parts go
Top view, part side up, column A on the left. Wires and links come in step 2.
pins in A05–A13 and G05–G13, USB-C up
pins in N05–N13 and T05–T13, USB-C up
A14 → E14, lying flat. Band (cathode) at A14, next to the H2's 5V pin
columns I and L, rows 05–13, notch up. Chip pushed to the top (pin 1 = I13); rows 05–06 stay empty
H12 → H08, lying flat, between the H2 and the socket
+ in P03, − in P01 (stripe on the can towards the GND strip)
S01–S03, openings to the right edge: S03 = 5V, S02 = DIN, S01 = GND
Neither strip touches any hole: wires get soldered onto them. Board, part and pin positions are to scale; the boards' outlines are dashed.
